text:
clara: Heads-up  I'm proposing a short 'Quickfix' section in the consolidated error-ref page: one-line triage + 3 copy-paste snippets (Node/Python/CLI). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4602

hui: Love the idea. Keep the Quickfix super terse 0-80 chars per snippet so it's easy to paste into existing code.

marc: Suggest the triage bullets be: 1) Is it a 429 or a timeout? 2) Try graceful fallback (cheaper model) once. 3) Capture trace headers and open a support ticket if it repeats.

neel: I'll author the snippets. CLI snippet first (console):
```
# quick fallback (console)
ri request --model default --on-429 fallback=gpt-lite --header "X-RI-Retry-Mode: graceful"
```

neel: Node snippet (ultra-compact):
```js
// quick fallback on 429
const r = await client.generate({prompt});
if(r.status===429) await client.generate({prompt,model:'gpt-lite',headers:{'X-RI-Retry-Mode':'graceful'}});
```

neel: Python snippet (ultra-compact):
```py
r = client.generate(prompt)
if r.status_code==429: client.generate(prompt, model='gpt-lite', headers={'X-RI-Retry-Mode':'graceful'})
```

sam: Add one-line migration note: "If you used a client-side retry wrapper, disable it or set X-RI-Retry-Mode=disabled to avoid duplicate attempts when using the unified server-side handler." Keep it a single sentence.

marc: Please add a tiny troubleshooting bullet about context-limit breakage: recommend trimming user history first (recent user turns) and show a before/after snippet using the console helper: `context-trim --drop=recent-user --max-tokens=2000`. Mention system anchors last.

clara: Ops wants short observability guidance: include recommended headers to attach for support correlation: `X-RI-Route`, `X-RI-Trace`, `X-RI-Retry-Mode`. Example prose line (not code).

doc-bot: lint: docs/error-ref.md flagged 3 broken anchors and 1 style warning. CI link: https://ci.redwood.dev/5120/checks

hui: I'll run the anchor/redirect sweep after we land the snippets. Please ensure all old /docs/retries/* links redirect to /docs/error-ref or are updated to the new anchors.

marc: Edge-case to capture: streaming partials + mid-stream 429. Advice: abort the stream, mark response partial, and only resume if backend supports `X-RI-Resume-Offset` (include last-token index). Add one short bullet.

clara: Plan: neel pushes snippets + CLI example, sam writes migration sentence, hui runs the link sweep post-merge. Target: merge next Tue after CI is green. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
